services.name: Docent Tours
services.desc: The de Saisset Museum offers free guided tours of the California Stories from Thámien to Santa Clara exhibition, Mission Santa Clara de Asís, and the nearby Mission Gardens. Our team of trained docents uses a variety of interactive methods to bring the history of Santa Clara Valley alive. Designed to complement California's state-mandated curriculum, the tour is geared primarily toward 4th grade school groups who are studying California mission history; the tour can be adapted to other age groups, upon request and pending availability.
